name: Manahime
source: Daughter of Haguro Hizen-no-kami Genjou, the former lord of Hizen. She became the proxy ruler after her father's sudden death from illness. True to her status as a princess, she's naive and unworldly, yet kind and compassionate to everyone. She readily accepts the mysterious Setsuran into her service as strategist. Her curious nature sometimes leads her to sneak onto the battlefield disguised as a foot soldier to follow Uneme...
